единицы.утверждение_en: Gemini 3 Pro Image is the next generation in the Gemini series of natively multimodal reasoning models and is described as Google's most advanced model for image generation; it can comprehend inputs from text and images.
единицы.цитата:
Description: Gemini 3 Pro Image is the next generation in the Gemini series of models, a suite of
highly-capable, natively multimodal, reasoning models. Gemini 3 Pro Image is now Google’s most
advanced model for image generation and can comprehend vast datasets, challenging problems from
different information sources, including text and images.
единицы.заметка: Позиционирование на ноябрь 2025.

единицы.утверждение_en: Gemini 3 Pro Image is based on Gemini 3 Pro.
единицы.цитата: Model dependencies: Gemini 3 Pro Image is based on Gemini 3 Pro.
единицы.заметка: Повторено в Architecture, Training Dataset, Distribution.

единицы.утверждение_en: Inputs are text strings (e.g. a question, a prompt, documents to be summarized) and images, with a token context window of up to 1M.
единицы.цитата:
Inputs: Text strings (e.g. a question, a prompt, document(s) to be summarized), images, with a token
context window of up to 1M.
единицы.заметка: Число входных изображений не указано.

единицы.утверждение_en: Gemini 3 Pro Image was evaluated with human evaluations of several quality aspects of image generation, with prompt sets in two categories.
единицы.цитата:
Human evaluations of several different quality aspects of image generation were conducted.
       Prompt sets for human evaluations were in two broad categories:

единицы.утверждение_en: New capability sets are diverse T2I and editing evals covering text, style, character, reasoning, factuality, infographics, ink (doodle) based editing, multi-turn, and multi-image (visual design, virtual try on, product recontextualization, etc.).
единицы.цитата:
New capability sets: diverse T2I and editing evals are curated, covering a wide range of
              capabilities, e.g. text, style, character, reasoning, factuality, infographics, ink (doodle)
              based editing, multi-turn, multi-image (visual design, virtual try on, product
              recontextualization, etc.)
единицы.заметка: Косвенно перечисляет поддерживаемые классы задач, в т.ч. virtual try on и product recontextualization в мульти-изображении.

единицы.утверждение_en: Regression sets use popular use cases observed on Gemini 2.5 Flash Image, to ensure Gemini 3 Pro Image shows no noticeable regression.
единицы.цитата:
Regression sets: popular use cases observed on Gemini 2.5 Flash Image, to ensure
              Gemini 3 Pro Image does not show noticeable regression.

единицы.утверждение_en: Benchmarks: existing capabilities — Text Rendering, Stylization, Multi-Turn, General Image Editing, Character Editing, Object/Environment Editing, Generate Text-to-Image and Regressions; new capabilities — Multi character editing, Chart editing, Text editing, Factuality - Edu, Multi-input, Infographics, Doodle editing and Visual design.
единицы.цитата:
Capabilities / Benchmarks: human evaluations were conducted on these benchmarks:
          ○​ Existing Capabilities: Text Rendering, Stylization, Multi-Turn, General Image Editing,
              Character Editing, Object/Environment Editing, Generate Text-to-Image and
              Regressions.
          ○​ New Capabilities: Multi character editing, Chart editing, Text editing, Factuality - Edu,
              Multi-input, Infographics, Doodle editing and Visual design.
единицы.заметка: 'Chart editing' и 'Text editing' — редактирование графиков и текста на изображениях как отдельные способности.

единицы.утверждение_en: Gemini 3 Pro Image leads on Elo across all new capabilities and regression sets, with significant margins in complex tasks such as multi-character, chart and text editing, and improves substantially in style compared to Gemini 2.5 Flash Image.
единицы.цитата:
Results: Gemini 3 Pro Image demonstrated strong performance and leads on Elo score across all new
capabilities and regression sets. It leads with significant margins in complex tasks, e.g. multi-character,
chart and text editing. It improves substantially in style compared to Gemini 2.5 Flash Image.

единицы.утверждение_en: Gemini 3 Pro Image is described as Google's most powerful AI image editing model yet, able to use Gemini's real-world knowledge to deliver precise results, from complex infographics to historically accurate scenes.
единицы.цитата:
Benefit and Intended Usage: Gemini 3 Pro Image is our most powerful AI image editing model yet,
capable of using Gemini’s real-world knowledge to deliver precise results, from complex infographics to
historically accurate scenes.

длинная_дистанция.утверждение_en: Gemini 3 Pro Image (Search On) is ahead of every compared model on all 16 benchmark rows; the largest margins over the next model are Multi character editing (+216), Chart editing (+215) and Text editing (+201), the smallest are Visual design (+21), Stylization (+29), Regression sets (+42) and Text Rendering (+48 over GPT-Image 1).
длинная_дистанция.заметка: Разности посчитаны мной по таблицам; согласуется с абзацем Results.

длинная_дистанция.утверждение_en: All Gemini 3 Pro Image scores are reported for the 'Search On' configuration; the card gives no results with search off, so the numbers may not describe calls without search.

The card lists clear text for posters and diagrams as an intended use and Text Rendering/Text editing as top scores, yet names small text (often blurry at 1k), long paragraphs and page-length text as weak: in-image text works best short and prominent, and small text is a known risk at 1K.
длинная_дистанция.заметка: Рекомендация сформулирована мной из текста карточки.

длинная_дистанция.утверждение_en: Doodle editing is benchmarked as a new capability, but the same card lists partial instruction following and persistent ink in masked/doodle edits, occasional copy-paste of the input image and left/right confusion — so doodle/mask and spatially-worded edits need verification.
Multi-input editing was benchmarked only for 1–3 input images ('Multi-input 1-3'); the card gives no maximum number of input images.

Каналы распространения не перечислены (отсылка к карточке Gemini 3 Pro).
